question: What is the name of the author with the most papers in 2009?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "authors" AS SELECT CAST(author_id AS VARCHAR) AS author_id,
       name AS name,
       CAST(email AS VARCHAR) AS email
FROM table_1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paper_author" AS WITH split AS (
  SELECT
    paper_author_combined,
    STRSPLIT(paper_author_combined, '|') AS parts
  FROM table_2
)
SELECT
  CAST(parts[1] AS VARCHAR) AS paper_id,
  CAST(parts[2] AS VARCHAR) AS author_id

WHERE parts IS NOT NULL AND LIST_LENGTH(parts) = 2

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "papers" AS SELECT CAST(paper_id AS VARCHAR) AS paper_id,
       title AS title,
       venue AS venue,
       CAST(year AS VARCHAR) AS year
FROM table_3

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paper_author" AS WITH split AS (
  SELECT

  FROM table_2
)
SELECT
  CAST(parts[1] AS VARCHAR) AS paper_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paper_author" AS WITH split AS (
  SELECT
    paper_author_combined,
    str_split(paper_author_combined, '|') AS parts
  FROM table_2
)
SELECT
  CAST(parts[1] AS VARCHAR) AS paper_id,

FROM split

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH pa AS (
  SELECT paper_id, author_id FROM paper_author
), p2009 AS (
  SELECT paper_id FROM papers WHERE year = '2009'
), joined AS (
  SELECT pa.author_id
  FROM pa
  INNER JOIN p2009 USING(paper_id)
), counts AS (
  SELECT author_id, COUNT(*) AS paper_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY author_id
), topk AS (
  SELECT * FROM counts
  ORDER BY paper_count DESC, author_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT a.name AS author_name, t.paper_count
FROM topk t
LEFT JOIN authors a ON a.author_id = t.author_id;

# Return top author for 2009; include author_id and fallback to author_id when name missing.
query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH cleaned_papers AS (
  SELECT paper_id,
         TRIM(REPLACE(year, '"', '')) AS year_str
  FROM papers
), p2009 AS (
  SELECT paper_id FROM cleaned_papers WHERE year_str = '2009' OR CAST(NULLIF(year_str, '') AS INTEGER) = 2009
), pa AS (
  SELECT paper_id, author_id FROM paper_author
), joined_2009 AS (
  SELECT pa.author_id
  FROM pa INNER JOIN p2009 USING(paper_id)
), counts_2009 AS (
  SELECT author_id, COUNT(*) AS paper_count FROM joined_2009 GROUP BY author_id
), top_2009 AS (
  SELECT author_id, paper_count FROM counts_2009 ORDER BY paper_count DESC, author_id ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(a.name, '(name missing)') AS author_name,
       t.author_id,
       t.paper_count
FROM top_2009 t
LEFT JOIN authors a ON a.author_id = t.author_id;
'''

_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, query)
